name: Smart Contract Security Review
description: Security review of smart contracts, primarily Solidity on the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM). Covers common weakness classes (reentrancy, access control, oracle and price manipulation, arithmetic, unchecked external calls), upgradeability patterns, static analysis and fuzzing tooling (e.g. Slither, Echidna, Foundry), and reporting against the SWC Registry and OWASP Smart Contract Top 10. General language-agnostic code review belongs to SWSEC-REVIEW-MANUAL.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to smart contract security review

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the EVM execution model and common smart contract weaknesses
evidence: Can explain accounts, transactions, gas, storage and external calls in the EVM
Can describe reentrancy, access control and oracle manipulation flaws with examples
Familiar with the SWC Registry and OWASP Smart Contract Top 10

2.label: Guided Practice
evidence: Reviewed Solidity contracts against a weakness checklist and documented findings
Ran Slither on a codebase and triaged its results
Wrote proof-of-concept tests for findings on a local or forked chain
Work reviewed by authorized reviewer

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently reviews production smart contract systems
evidence: Independently reviewed 5+ contract systems and produced severity-rated reports with remediation
Identifies cross-contract and economic attack paths (flash loans, price manipulation)
Reviews proxy and upgradeability patterns for storage collisions and initialization flaws
Writes property-based or invariant fuzz tests with Echidna or Foundry
Passed proficiency assessment on smart contract review

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Leads complex reviews; reasons about protocol-level and economic design
evidence: Leads reviews of multi-contract DeFi or bridge protocols, including scoping and threat modelling
Reviews signature schemes (EIP-712, permit) and cross-chain message validation
Develops custom static analysis detectors or invariant suites
Reviews reports and mentors junior reviewers

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Authority on smart contract security; defines methodology
evidence: Developed the lab's smart contract review methodology and reporting standard
Published research or disclosed significant vulnerabilities in deployed contracts
Reviews formal verification results or EVM bytecode-level behaviour
Trains teams on smart contract security review

assessment_methods.description: Review a submitted smart contract audit report for accuracy of findings, severity rating, proof-of-concept quality and remediation guidance
Review a prepared set of vulnerable Solidity contracts with seeded flaws and demonstrate exploitation on a local test chain
